_comment: Per-chart narratives. CI (build_prompt.py -> GitHub Models -> write_narrative.py) overwrites these from live numbers; this committed copy is the fallback so the page always reads well. source = 'fallback' | 'github-models'.

notes.basket: The breakfast basket, an average index of coffee, sugar, wheat, and orange juice prices set at 100 in 2015, currently stands at 132, indicating a 32% increase since 2015. This headline rise has not been steady but rather has occurred unevenly over time. The index reflects global commodity prices, which can be quite volatile. The recent climb highlights the sensitivity of these agricultural commodities to various external factors.
notes.movers: The largest contributors to the basket's increase are coffee, up 93%, and orange juice, up 22% since 2015. Wheat and sugar have seen more modest changes of 7% and 5%, respectively. These changes are primarily driven by weather events and crop diseases such as frost and drought affecting coffee, and citrus greening and hurricanes impacting orange juice. Because soft commodities trade in relatively thin markets, these localized factors can cause sharp movements in global prices.
notes.why: The rise in the breakfast basket is largely due to a few weather-exposed crops rather than broad inflationary pressures. Given the dependence on specific growing regions and susceptibility to environmental challenges, elevated commodity prices may persist over multiple years. This underlines the ongoing vulnerability of supply chains in soft commodity markets.
